about: Unicode text -> Shree-Lipi 7 Malayalam bytes (fonts SHREE-MAL7-0501/0502/0507/0508/0520 = S05xx890.TTF and Shree-Mal7-001/002 = WMAL7001/2.TTF: the same 189 codes on the same glyphs in all seven; no 4/5/6 Malayalam face is installed), answered by Shree's own composers S8MalU64.dll (TutorGetMappedCodeW, Unicode) and S8Mal764.dll (TutorGetMappedCode, raw bytes) for the same keystroke. bytes = the 7 composer's raw output, one hex byte per glyph code (bytes 80-9F are raw bytes: in a document they sit on their Windows-1252 code points). Every probe set and every vendor keyboard was captured twice in separate processes: byte-identical. kind: vendor-key = a key (layer 0, Ctrl+Space, or the composer raw code layer) of one of the 15 shipped .MAL keyboards loaded from its ORIGINAL path (the composers switch typing mode by name: ENG/PHONETIC/ISMENG/NEWROMA/ROMA are phonetic); source names the keyboard, key and codes. canonical = probe in Shree's typing order for Malayalam, which is VISUAL order: the pre-base signs െ (73 -> 52) and േ (53 -> 53), ൈ = 73 73 (52 52), and the ra sign ്ര (59 -> 4E) are struck BEFORE the letter or cluster, the pre-base sign before the ra sign (െ ്ര ക = 52 4E 57); then the consonant; then ്യ (55 -> 7C) / ്വ (49 -> 7E); then the post-base sign (ാ 4C ി 5D ീ 7D ു 4F ൂ 50 ൃ 51 ൗ 54; ൊ = 52 C 4C, ോ = 53 C 4C, ൌ = 52 C 54); then ം 55 / ഃ 40. Conjuncts through the link code 64: one of 55 ligatures (ക്ക A8, ക്ത A9, ന്ത CD, റ്റ E3 ...), C1 + a subjoined form of C2 (ട 9B, ത C5, ദ C9, ധ 9C, ന D4, പ D7, മ DC, ല/ള E6, സ F5, and the doubling stroke FF for ച്ച ബ്ബ വ്വ), or C1 + the chandrakkala 56 + C2; a pending link = the chandrakkala (ക് = 57 56). Chillus are atomic codes (ർ A1 ൽ A4 ൺ A6 ൻ A2 ൾ A5; ൿ has no glyph). canonical:halant = code 44 (virama + ZWNJ: 56). canonical:by-codes = the Unicode composer dropped the sign after ്യ/്വ, the row is filed under what the codes mean. preferred: vendor key, then canonical, then the link spelling (യ്യ: E1 over യ + ya sign 70 7C; വ്വ: 76 FF over വ + va sign 76 7E - the only strings with two canonical spellings), then fewer bytes, then more probes; accepted keeps every canonical spelling. alt:* = the composer answer for another typing order or another visual form (a pre-base sign struck after its letter; the ra sign struck before െ/േ; C + link + ര/യ/വ = the chandrakkala form, not the sign; ക + link + ഷ; C + link + ZWJ, the Unicode 5.0 chillu, which the 7 composer writes as C + 56; pieces with a leading link) - kept, not used as truth. quirk:* = the Unicode composer wrote something other than the codes mean, the 7 composer dropped a code (the precomposed DC DD DE DF, ഌ ൡ ൠ ഽ ൄ ൢ ൣ ൿ, ZWJ/ZWNJ, F0 ഐ, the fractions), a code only the 7 composer types (86, ED), a control byte (E2 link: 08; phonetic carrier 07), a lone sign, ശ്രീ E3 with something after it, the ra sign on C1്ശ - kept for evidence, not used. Unicode keys are NFC (െ+ാ = ൊ, േ+ാ = ോ, െ+ൗ = ൌ). Rules with examples: mal7-patterns.txt. Strings a table needs that the composer cannot be asked in one key (5+ codes): mal7-composer-gaps.json (derived, not truth).

fontCheck.method: fonts/family-check.json (fontcmp.js + ttf.js): (3,1) cmap of every installed Malayalam Shree-Lipi 7 face - WMAL7001/2.TTF (Shree-Mal7-001/002), S0501890/S0502890/S0507890/S0508890/S0520890.TTF (SHREE-MAL7-0501/0502/0507/0508/0520). No 4/5/6 Malayalam face (SHREE-MAL-xxxx) is installed on this PC.
fontCheck.result: All seven faces have the same 189 codes on the same code points and the same glyph ids (outlines and advances differ: they are different designs). ONE table serves every 7 face.
fontCheck.fontCodesNeverWrittenByTheComposer: 2D 84 85 86 87 88 89 8A 8B 8C 98 A0 A3 AD B7 DD DE E0 E2 E5 ED EE F0 FA FB FC FD FE

counts.notProbed: A conjunct slot holds at most 4 codes and the Tutor answers one key at a time with no state, so these are not in the truth (derived in mal7-composer-gaps.json): ൊ ോ ൌ ൈ on a two-consonant cluster (73 C1 64 C2 6C = 5 codes); the ra sign + a cluster + a sign or tail (59 C1 64 C2 + s); a cluster + ്യ/്വ + a sign; C1്C2്C3 (5 codes; the pieces "link C2 link C3" are probed); the dot reph ൎ U+0D4E (no code: no key on any vendor keyboard types it) and the candrabindu ഁ U+0D01, ഀ U+0D00, ഻ ഼ U+0D3B/0D3C, ൔ ൕ ൖ (chillu m/y/llla), ഩ ഺ (no codes).
